items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: "I got a telegram for Jimmie Lunceford. He wants you to join him in Akron, Ohio."

ctx.x: He came downtown and he says, "I got a telegram for Jimmie Lunceford. He wants you to join him in Akron, Ohio." Say, "Joe Thomas want to take a vacation." So, I called him up, I found his home. (inaudible). When I went home I called him up. Says, "I want you to join me in Akron, Ohio." This is like (inaudible). I says -- "It's only for two months, you know." So meanwhile, John Hammond told me to report to Radio City (inaudible), because he wanted me
